title: Uniform Perfectness and Centers in Sublinearly Morse Boundaries
summary: The $κ$--Morse boundary was introduced for CAT(0) spaces by Qing and Rafi and extended to proper geodesic spaces by Qing, Rafi, and Tiozzo. Motivated by Han and Liu's work on uniformly perfect Morse boundaries, we ask when uniform perfectness of visual boundary data detects $κ$--center exhaustivity. Two locally finite trees show that fixed-basepoint uniform perfectness is insufficient and, when $κ$ is unbounded, a basepoint-independent absolute annular cutoff is not necessary.
